claims.claim: CCEA approved the selected buyer on 14 October 2026; the transaction is not established as signed or closed.
claims.locator: PIB approval paragraph; Fairfax Transactions Conditional
claims.what_it_cannot_establish: Approval is not title transfer or proceeds received.

claims.claim: The approved consideration covers 60.72%, sold by both GoI and LIC.
claims.what_it_cannot_establish: The full price is not central-government revenue.

claims.claim: Government reports a revised valuation comparator after initial bids were rejected.
claims.what_it_cannot_establish: No independently replicated fair-value or undervaluation estimate; confidential valuation reports not read.

claims.claim: Fairfax describes funding sources as expected cash, credit and potential asset sales.
claims.what_it_cannot_establish: No named lender, committed facility amount, drawdown or guarantee is established.

claims.claim: Watsa controls Sixty Two; the proxy gives dated voting percentages at Fairfax.
claims.what_it_cannot_establish: Voting power is not economic ownership; the snapshot does not prove his current or direct IDBI ownership.

claims.claim: Digit and IIFL Capital contributions are separately proposed transactions.
claims.what_it_cannot_establish: They are not completed IDBI assets or evidence of purchase-price funding.

claims.claim: Air India completion transferred the specified airline/JV interests and delivered cash to government.
claims.short_extract: Government receiving a consideration of Rs 2,700 crore
claims.what_it_cannot_establish: Retained debt is not an additional cash sale receipt.

claims.claim: SBI CAPS reports Air India refinancing/additional-funding advisory of INR 14,000 crore in FY2022–23.
claims.what_it_cannot_establish: This later advisory scope is not proof of January 2022 acquisition funding or full cash disbursement.

claims.claim: NINL transfer completed at an enterprise value paid to settle several classes of dues and selling interests.
claims.what_it_cannot_establish: Enterprise value cannot be treated as direct GoI sale receipts.

claims.claim: Tata Steel reports two preference-share subscriptions funding TSLP growth including NINL.
claims.what_it_cannot_establish: The combined INR 12,700 crore is not entirely NINL price, and these instruments are not named bank loans.

claims.claim: Buyer confirms completion and seller confirms INR 320 crore received.
claims.what_it_cannot_establish: Does not identify acquisition lenders or ultimate beneficial owners.

claims.claim: The selected CEL bidder was disqualified and the current transaction terminated.
claims.what_it_cannot_establish: No completed private ownership or conviction is established.

claims.claim: Star9 consortium was disqualified and its EOI process annulled.
claims.what_it_cannot_establish: Not evidence that Pawan Hans was sold; 100% of GoI holding means 51% of company.

claims.claim: The 2020 BPCL EOI process was called off in May 2022.
claims.what_it_cannot_establish: Not permanent prohibition of future disinvestment; no successful private buyer in this process.

claims.claim: Dated minister and committee records describe institutional authority.
claims.what_it_cannot_establish: Holding office, approving a transaction or appearing in an ownership graph does not establish personal wrongdoing.
